meta_description: Barratt Garden Services in Birmingham offers professional garden maintenance, design, and landscaping. Local gardener serving Water Orton and surrounding areas.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden redesigns, we transform outdoor spaces across Birmingham and Water Orton.
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance, a complete redesign, or seasonal cleanup, we handle every aspect of garden care.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cutting, hedge trimming, and border care keeps your garden looking sharp year-round. We handle all the heavy lifting so you can relax and enjoy the space.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Turn a patchy lawn into the garden you've always wanted. We design layouts, source materials, and build everything from scratch — patios, raised beds, water features, the lot.

services.title: Lawn Care & Renovation
services.desc: Patchy grass? We scarify, aerate, overseed, and feed to bring your lawn back to life. Or we'll lay fresh turf for instant results.

services.title: Tree & Hedge Work
services.desc: Safe felling, crown reduction, and professional hedge cutting. We remove problem branches and shape mature trees to open up your garden and improve safety.

services.title: Seasonal Clearance & Tidy-ups
services.desc: Spring cleanup, autumn leaf collection, or pre-winter preparation — we clear gutters, tidy borders, and haul away the debris.

services.title: Patio & Pathway Installation
services.desc: Build a new patio or repair existing paving. We lay block paving, flagstone, and gravel to create usable outdoor living areas that last.

about_pullquote: A good garden should work for you, not against you.
about_para_1: Barratt Garden Services was founded on a simple frustration: too many gardeners treat yards as just another job. We've spent over 15 years in gardens across Birmingham and Water Orton, and we've learned that every space is different. Whether it's a steep slope, poor soil, or just an overgrown mess, we approach each project with a fresh eye and real solutions.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen. You tell us what you want — a low-maintenance family garden, a Mediterranean retreat, wildlife space — and we deliver exactly that. We're not after quick fixes; we build relationships with local families and businesses who trust us to care for their outdoor space year after year.

reviews.text: Absolute lifesaver. Our garden was a jungle when we moved in — brambles everywhere, overgrown roses strangling the fence. Barratt came round, gave us honest advice without trying to upsell, and in two days it was transformed. Now we actually use the space. He's brilliant.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had Dave maintain our garden every fortnight for two years now. Reliable, tidy, never messes about. He knows exactly what needs doing and he does it without faffing. Fair prices too. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: Redesigned our whole back garden from scratch. Laid a patio, new borders, turf — the works. They were professional, on time, and tidied up properly every day. Our kids love it now. Highly recommend if you're serious about improving your outdoor space.
reviews.author: James L.
